title: Good replacement but no instructions
text:
Good replacement but no instructions. I've had a Dyson for years and it always seemed under powered to me, so I decided to get this and see if it works better. I was surprised when I got the package and there were no instructions. It's not like replacing a battery in a flashlight, you have to take the Dyson apart in order to install the new battery, so it really should come with instructions, which is why I only gave it 3 stars.
I didn't really notice a large difference in performance, so I don't really know if it's more powerful than the standard battery on the Dyson. I wasn't about to swap them out since it does take some time to do that, and so I assume it's as good as the Dyson but not significantly better.
